name: form-expressions
description: Survey expressions are checked by Smap's own parser and checker (form-expressions.json) in place of the JavaRosa library, when a survey is uploaded and, newly, when it is changed in the online editor or through MCP (2026-11-25, 26.12.01). A change whose relevant, constraint, calculation or choice filter cannot be read, names a function that does not exist or gives it the wrong number of arguments, or makes calculations depend on each other in a loop, is refused with a message naming the question, the column and the character, and nothing is saved. A function used wrongly in a constraint, which JavaRosa never found, is saved with a warning for now. Keeps its survey; no records.

refused.name: == for =
refused.question: fe_a
refused.expect: == is not an operator here, use =

loop.expect: depend on each other in a loop

warned.question: fe_b
warned.expect: there is no function called nosuchfn()
